title: Hall effect (2D)
description: A current through a semiconductor bar in a perpendicular field B: the 2-D potential with the Drude conductivity tensor (insulating edges carry the Hall condition), the Hall voltage at mid-length and the Hall coefficient against 1/(n q); the contacts short the Hall field in a short bar, shown by sweeping the length.

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: Hall coefficient R_H = E_y / (J_x B)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: Drude: R_H = 1/(n q) (Ashcroft & Mermin eq. 1.15))

metrics.name: 2D: current
metrics.how: integral of J_x across the mid-section x thickness

checks.name: [2D] Hall coefficient R_H = E_y / (J_x B)
checks.label: Hall coefficient R_H = E_y / (J_x B) vs closed form

Popovic, Hall Effect Devices, 2nd ed. (2004), sec. 4.2 (geometrical factor)
